summary: Frontend-only regression + new-mechanic test on TrapShift Preview URL. Verified (a) death/fall/respawn from earlier iteration still works, (b) new checkpoint respawn on L3, and (c) new SWITCH -> GATE mechanic on L6. TEST 1 (L1 First Steps fall death/respawn): PASS - holding ArrowRight walks off platform, dies and respawns at start; deaths HUD counted 2 -> 5 -> 7 -> 10 across 4 repeated ArrowRight holds; manual R -> 11 deaths; no soft-lock; controls remained responsive. TEST 2 (L3 Watch Your Step checkpoint): PASS - stepping onto cyan checkpoint beacon rendered toast [data-testid=checkpoint-toast] with text 'Checkpoint!'; subsequent falls into pits kept incrementing deaths (4 -> 7) with respawn continuing without soft-lock. TEST 3 (L6 The Lever switch->gate NEW mechanic): PASS - initial screenshot clearly shows RED energy gate barrier blocking corridor mid-level; on holding ArrowRight, player stepped onto amber switch pad and a 'Gate opened!' toast [data-testid=checkpoint-toast] appeared while the red gate visually powered down (post screenshot shows only dashed outline where the gate was). No console errors during any test. TEST 5 (finish-flag completion + Next overlay) NOT AUTOMATED - skill-gated jumping/precise platforming to green flag; developer unit tests already cover solvability & progression per the request.

issues: Level tiles missing data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='level-card-w1-1'); had to select by button text. Adding testids would improve testability.

action_items: Consider adding data-testid attributes to level select buttons in src/components/LevelSelect.tsx (e.g., data-testid={`level-card-${l.id}`}) to make automated testing more robust.
critical_code_review_comments: All three critical behaviors specified in the request are working correctly at runtime: death/fall/respawn, checkpoint respawn, and the new switch->gate mechanic (visible red gate barrier + 'Gate opened!' toast + gate disappears on switch press).

Toast for both 'Checkpoint!' and 'Gate opened!' shares the same data-testid='checkpoint-toast'; not incorrect per request but worth noting - a distinct 'gate-toast' testid would allow cleaner assertions.
Level select buttons lack data-testid — see design_issues.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of automatable tests passed (TEST 5 finish-flag completion intentionally not automated per request; solvability covered by developer unit tests)

To test L1 death/respawn: Play Story -> Neon Foundry -> click button with text '1' -> Start -> hold ArrowRight; deaths HUD (right-side of HUD, text 'N deaths' appears after first death) will increment.
